description: Run named multi-step Git workflows with resumable lifecycle controls. Use action=start|status|continue|abort|list with workflow families such as snapshot, replay, branch_surgery, and publish.

action.description: Lifecycle action for git_workflow execution and state management.

backup_branch.description: Backup branch name for branch_surgery workflow.

base_branch.description: Base branch for snapshot merge-base checks (default: main).

confirm_hard_reset.description: Required true when reset_to is provided because hard reset is destructive.

log_count.description: Commit count for snapshot log output.

patch_files.description: Patch/mailbox file list for replay mode=am.

publish.description: Deprecated alias for auto_publish; retained for backward compatibility.

rebase_onto.description: Optional rebase target before publish push step.

remote.description: Remote name for publish-related steps (default: origin).

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the local Git repository. If omitted, falls back to the server default set via the GIT_REPO_PATH environment variable or --repo-path CLI argument.

reset_to.description: Optional hard-reset target in replay/branch_surgery workflows.

source_commits.description: Commit list for replay and branch_surgery flows.

three_way.description: Use --3way when applying patch series via git am.

workflow.description: Named workflow family for multi-step Git orchestration.

name: git_workflow
title: Git Workflow Orchestrator
